topics.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO following government intervention
topics.explanation: Nvidia's board has unanimously voted to bring back Jensen Huang as CEO and president, just days after he resigned amid a scandal involving extramarital affairs. President Donald Trump confirmed he personally lobbied the board to reinstate Huang, citing him as a national security asset, while the company faces ongoing scrutiny regarding its chip exports.
topics.why_it_matters: As a central player in the AI industry, Nvidia's leadership stability is critical for market sentiment, with the stock surging significantly on the news and helping to lift broader tech indices.

topics.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler in $44 billion deal
topics.explanation: Cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike has announced a $44 billion all-stock acquisition of Zscaler. The deal is aimed at bolstering defenses against increasingly sophisticated AI-driven cyberattacks.
topics.why_it_matters: This massive consolidation in the cybersecurity sector highlights the growing corporate spending on digital infrastructure as AI-powered threats become a primary concern for global enterprises.

topics.title: COP31 climate summit ends without a consensus deal
topics.explanation: The U.N.'s COP31 climate conference concluded in failure after governments and campaigners rejected a draft deal that excluded fossil fuels. The summit, which became the longest in history, failed to reach an agreement on climate finance and energy transition goals.
topics.why_it_matters: The collapse of these international climate talks creates uncertainty for global energy policy and the transition strategies of major industrial companies.

topics.title: Oil prices slide as supply concerns clash with geopolitical tensions
topics.explanation: Crude oil prices fell on Monday, with WTI dropping nearly 4% as market participants weighed rising supply against ongoing attacks on energy infrastructure in the Middle East and Russia. Disruptions in Libya and attacks on Saudi facilities continue to create volatility in energy markets.
topics.why_it_matters: Energy prices are a key driver of global inflation, and supply chain disruptions in major oil-producing regions can quickly impact consumer costs and corporate profitability.
